component.name: Paint
component.summary: Draw and paint images in a clean GNOME workspace

description.p: Paint is a fast, distraction-free raster drawing and painting application built with GTK 4, Libadwaita, and Cairo in the style of GNOME Text Editor and Ptyxis.

ul.li: Smooth anti-aliased brush, eraser, and tolerance-aware flood fill tools
Tabbed canvases with tab overview and drag-out window tear-off
Automatic session restore preserving open tabs and unsaved drafts
Touchscreen-friendly canvas with zoom, pan, and customizable defaults
Open and export PNG, JPEG, WebP, and BMP images

description.p: Initial release with tabbed canvases, brush, eraser, flood fill, session restore, and Adwaita preferences.
